checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One assembled 15-second 16:9 film with three garden scenes
must.why: Single 5 s square clip on a park bench; no garden scenes.

must.item: Leads resemble the portrait photos (curly dark hair; short grey hair)
must.why: Both are recognizably similar; the woman has curly dark hair and the man short grey hair, with some slight drift in the faces.

must.item: Woman reacts with disappointment to an empty flowerpot
Man reveals a small flowering plant; both plant it in the pot
must.why: No plant, no pot, no planting.

must.item: Ending shows both smiling, and the film has no audible soundtrack
must.why: Both smile at the end, but the clip has ambient sound (peak -1.2 dB), so the silence requirement is not met.

faults.what: The story and plot required (garden, flowerpot, gift reveal, planting) are entirely absent; a generic park bench scene was made instead.
The length is 5 s rather than 15 s, the format is square rather than 16:9, and it is a single scene rather than three.
The clip has an audible ambient soundtrack where none was wanted.
The man is noticeably older and rougher-looking than in the portrait, and the faces drift slightly.
The low 480p resolution and the mouth movement look like typical AI artefacts.

summary: The clip is a clean 5 s square park-bench scene with two recognizable people smiling, but it misses the required 15 s three-scene garden story, flowerpot and plant beats, 16:9 format and silence.
